MarchingCubesInput
  export interface MarchingCubesInput { /** Scalar grid, x-major: `values[x + nx * (y + ny * z)]`. */ readonly values: Float32Array; /** Grid dimensions `[nx, ny, nz]`, each an integer ≥ 2. */ readonly dims: readonly [number, number, number]; /** Isovalue; a corner is "inside" when its value is below it. Default 0. */ readonly level?: number; /** World position of grid point (0, 0, 0). Default `[0, 0, 0]`. */ readonly origin?: readonly [number, number, number]; /** World distance between grid points on each axis (nonzero). Default `[1, 1, 1]`. */ readonly spacing?: readonly [number, number, number] }
